name: Conrad Bora Bora Nui
insider_take: This overwater paradise sits on a private motu with unobstructed views of Mount Otemanu, Bora Bora's legendary volcanic peak that rises 2,385 feet from the lagoon.
whats_special: The resort features Polynesia's first hilltop villas accessible by funicular, plus overwater villas with glass-bottom viewing panels. The property spans 44 acres on Motu To'opua, completely surrounded by coral gardens and home to the island's largest infinity pool.
pro_tip: Book a hilltop villa during whale season (July-November) for front-row seats to humpback whale migrations right from your private deck.
dont_miss: The resort's private lagoon sanctuary where blacktip reef sharks and stingrays gather daily, and sunset cocktails at the Tamure Beach Bar—the only spot on the island where you can watch the sun set directly behind Mount Otemanu.
pros: Iconic overwater villas with direct lagoon access and glass floor panels
Spectacular Mount Otemanu and turquoise lagoon views from every accommodation
Premium Conrad luxury service and amenities in French Polynesia paradise
Multiple dining options featuring fresh local seafood and international cuisine
cons: Remote island location requires multi-stop travel and boat transfers
Premium pricing reflects exclusive luxury positioning and limited availability
